A1_roster_api_wired.description: SystemSettings.tsx calls api.getRoster() on mount; GET /api/v1/roster returns CoreAdapter.roster() (the static worker registry from wicked-core)

A2_registry_read_only.description: No API to add/remove/modify worker definitions from the UI. The registry is served by GET /roster only; no PATCH/PUT/DELETE /roster route exists. The UI cannot mutate the registry.

A3_seats_displayed.description: Each RosterSeat's display_name and key are rendered in the Default CLIs section. enabled_for_council drives initial checkbox state. Additional seat fields pass through via [k: string]: unknown index signature.

A4_local_preference_only.description: The 'Save CLI defaults' action persists selected keys to localStorage (key: wicked_default_clis) only — it does not call any server endpoint. This is a UI convenience (pre-selection for new sessions), not a registry mutation.

A5_tests_pass.description: 155 studio tests pass (20 test files). getRoster() is stubbed in 3 test files; the studio test suite exercises the full component tree without regressions.

note: The 'Default CLIs' section in SystemSettings satisfies 'worker registry view (read-only in v1)': it fetches and displays all registered worker seats from the daemon API; no UI surface allows adding, removing, or modifying seat definitions. The only user-editable preference (which CLIs are pre-selected in the launch form) is stored in localStorage and does not mutate the registry.
